cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got the garden improvement under control. A little pond will make the front look lovely, if you're happy with it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What about the tree? I like the shade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've arranged a bench with a canopy. You can choose where it goes; I want your shady corner kept.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are you replacing the tree's shade? Where is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's been cut down. I'll stop the grinder until you've chosen what happens next. If I keep that corner shaded exactly as you want, can we call the pond a good decision?

reason: Let B value shade determine A canopy/choice concession; reveal completed cutting and seek retrospective approval while A confidently yields control of remaining details.
